internalNodes.name: 公告财报采集
internalNodes.description: Collect primary company disclosures, HKEX announcements, financial statements, segment data, share count, net cash/debt, and management guidance. Capture exact values with period/unit/currency and source ids. Do not analyze valuation.
internalNodes.userPrompt:
Collect primary company disclosures, HKEX announcements, financial statements, segment data, share count, net cash/debt, and management guidance. Capture exact values with period/unit/currency and source ids. Do not analyze valuation.

Output only a compact evidence_pack for downstream use: include only claims with source_ids and metric_ids, metrics with exact values/period/unit/source_ids, and specific source URLs. Put rejected, unverified, or workflow-process details into blocking_gaps/data_gaps instead of evidence_pack.

Build evidence_pack as the primary downstream asset; handoff_summary is only a concise routing summary.
